text:
Alex W: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in fncall schema rejections that are being routed to the fallback/degen path. ~10% of /chat fncalls in eu-west rolling canary are hitting schema_fail -> soft-route. Billing and quota dashboards show churn. Anyone change validator rules recently?

Maria S: I didn't push anything to prod. I do see a canary last night for stricter enum validation. @TJ did your rollout toggle touch the validator?

TJ: Yep, I merged the enum-strictness toggle into canary. It was supposed to be in soft-validate mode but my rollout script accidentally set VALIDATOR_MODE=strict for 10% of traffic. Rolling that back now. Sorry.

Alex W: Can you confirm rollback? Need to stabilize routing — console is already showing the "fallback" model as the billed model for ~100k calls which will blow cost forecasts if left.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed on ring=canary at 1719876600 :white_check_mark:

Eve K: We also need to sort billing attribution. Right now the billing table attributes cost to the original model but the runtime charged degen GPU. Product wants clear audit trail so customers don't get surprised on invoices.

Maria S: Proposal: add a route-level meter tag "schema_fallback" and allow two billing attributions: PRESERVE_CUSTOMER (current) or BILL_TO_FALLBACK_MODEL. Default should be conservative — maybe PRESERVE_CUSTOMER but surface in console. Thoughts?

TJ: Counterpoint: some enterprise customers explicitly want fallback billed to the fallback model so they can see cost of degraded output. We should support per-account config. Default can be PRESERVE_CUSTOMER but allow opt-in. Also need tests for downstream billing pipeline.

Alex W: We should also improve telemetry granularity. Add a label schema_fail_reason with enums like enum_mismatch, missing_required_field, parse_error, type_coercion. That will make heatmaps actionable. Also sample full failed payloads at 1% and scrub PII.

Maria S: Dashboard change request: new "Fncall Schema Rejections" panel showing top reasons, top routes, %impact on latency, and canary overlay. Include a sparklines column for recent 1h/24h trends.

prod-bot: feature-flags: rollout 'fncall-soft-route' -> 10% enabled for accounts with usage > 1M tokens

TJ: For rollout UX we need a per-account toggle in Console with clear text: "Enabling soft-route will route schema failures to a fallback model; you may be billed for the fallback model unless you change billing preferences." Also show expected cost delta estimate.

Eve K: Actionable migration plan suggestion: 1) ensure rollback to previous validator (done) 2) enable soft-route default only in canary 3) add telemetry labels and sampling 4) implement dashboard and per-account console flags 5) add billing preference opt-in + docs + alerting

Alex W: Agreed. I'll own telemetry + dashboard. @Maria S can you own billing RFC? Put matrix of customer_preference x default_behavior + sample billing events.

Maria S: Will do. Drafting RFC today — will include examples and invoice snippets.

TJ: I'll open a PR to make validator toggle explicit and add integration tests that assert the billing tag is set on fallback. Proposal proto snippet for policy:
```yaml
on_schema_fail:
  mode: SOFT_ROUTE
  fallback_model: redwood-degen-v1
  billing_attribution: BILL_TO_FALLBACK_MODEL
  sample_failed_payload_rate: 0.01
```
Use uppercase enums for clarity.

Eve K: Quick product question: do we propagate function/tool identity to the fallback request? Some toolhooks rely on tool identity for auth and side-effects.

Alex W: Keep the tool identity in the payload but tag call.metadata.origin = "fallback" and call.metadata.schema_fail_reason set when present. That gives tools the signal without breaking signatures.

sre-bot: alert: correlated quota-exhaustion spikes with fallback routing at 1719876690. Investigating bucket saturation for dedicated pools.

Alex W: OK — I'll open a tracking ticket and link the RFC drafts and dashboard mockups. Short term: rollback fixed the immediate spike. Long term: RFC + telemetry + console flags + billing opt-in.

TJ: I'll follow up with the validator PR and tests.

Maria S: I'll post the billing RFC by EOD and link to sample invoice events.

Eve K: Thanks all. Quick wins: revert strictness (done), add schema_fail_reason label (Alex), add minimal dashboard tile (Alex).

Alex W: Thanks team. I'll post ticket/# for tracking. If anyone sees related alerts, ping me or @sre-bot.
